messages.subject: problem in simulation distributions
parts:
Hello, there is a problem in simulation distributions in determining a value Skwness and kurtosis. The following message appears, and the other question is what are the values Skwness and kurtosis the following distributions when the data is ordinal Moderate Asymmetry; Moderate Asymmetry-Alternating; Exteme Asymmetry; Extreme Asymmetry-Alternating. S = skew; K = kurtosis.with catigorical (5)

> skewness=0.92L

Warning message:

integer literal 0.92L contains decimal; using numeric value 

> kurtosis=0.80L

Warning message:

integer literal 0.80L contains decimal; using numeric value

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: problem in simulation distributions
parts:
> > skewness=0.92L

Just remove the 'L' after 0.92. The 'L' is only for integers. For example:

x <- 1L
class(x)
# integer

y <- 1
class(y)
# numeric

Yves.
